doc_friction.issue: the Reproduce section says Yosys 0.70 from the nixpkgs cache, but nixpkgs-unstable now builds Yosys 0.71 and no nixpkgs revision is pinned anywhere in the project, so the tool version silently changed between milestones 144 and 145

a long foreground wait_for call (540 s) was killed with exit 137 when the worker restarted; the guidance on long commands does not mention that a worker restart also kills nohup'd background flows, so --resume support in every flow script is what saved the run

goal: advance the verified-dse programme by one pre-registered blind milestone
notes: Flow: 20 fresh 128-bit designs (10 add-chain, 10 control) x 120 ABC sequences at ff_n40C_1v95, OpenROAD 26Q3 + Yosys 0.71, about 70 min on 4 cores. Predictions committed in 3b6e2c8f3 before any point. Four of seven held; the primary (Fisher, losses ADD 3/10 vs CTRL 0/10, p = 0.105) was refuted; the mean-edge difference held (+7.26 points, permutation p = 0.026), as did the mechanism (median r2-vs-routed tau-b 0.27 vs 0.47). A post-hoc confound section (labelled) shows the groups do not overlap in mapped delay. Local checks: tests/test_addchain_ff.py 4 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links ok; check_posts ok; research_live_links no change. Full verified-dse suite: 2 pre-existing failures (test_ladder_confirm*.py::test_designs_are_unseen, failing since milestone 141 because milestones 141 to 144 rerun those blind designs at other operating points) fixed by excluding those rerun tables; then all pass (198 passed, 1 skipped, plus the 8 in the two fixed files).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
